description: Internal alterations comprising at fourth floor level, the reconfiguration of kitchen and bathroom facilities, enlargement of opening between kitchen and dining room and reconfiguration of (non-original) stair, at fifth floor level, reconfiguration of the layout to create 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. External alterations comprising new stairs to the roof terrace, relocation of the water tank from the closet return roof at fifth floor level to the main roof and consolidation and reconfiguration of the existing water tanks and their enclosures at roof level and the inclusion of a new condenser unit within an acoustic enclosure (to provide AC to the whole apartment) and new sliding, glazed, flush roof access enclosure to provide access to the (existing) roof terrace via the new stairs.
